verdict.rationale: Firebase Local Emulator Suite documented (firebase-docs-24, firebase-docs-9) covers Firestore, Realtime Database, Storage, Auth, Hosting, Functions, Pub/Sub, and Extensions locally, and firebase-tools CLI is confirmed runnable via hands-on probe (firebase-probe-5) with local hosting server and Auth import/export (firebase-gh-1/2/3). missing for 10: independent hands-on report of running the full multi-service emulator suite together (only CLI version check and doc claims verified), and no community confirmation of emulator reliability/completeness.
